description: On the bed in front of you there’s a white pedestal-shaped piece and a small white cup-like piece sitting beside it, with a pillow in the background. The left hand slides in from the lower left to steady the pedestal at its base as the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the cup-like piece (right-hand object), lifts it up and over the pedestal, then lowers and seats it onto the top before releasing.
